```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)
library(sf)
library(ggdark)
source('Reapportionment.R')
```

Read in Parcel, FLU, and Cluster data
```{r, message = FALSE}
epsg_id <- 26967
  
GIS_data_path <- '../../../Henry County GIS Data'
flu_path <- paste0(GIS_data_path, '/Georgia Smart Communities/Future Land Use.shp')
parcel_path <- paste0(GIS_data_path, '/Georgia Smart Communities/Parcels.shp')
cluster_path <- paste0(GIS_data_path, '/Change/Areas/areas_c_type.shp')
roads_path <- paste0(GIS_data_path, '/Georgia Smart Communities/Roads.shp')
city_point_path <- paste0(GIS_data_path, '/Georgia Smart Communities/City_Points.shp')
city_limit_path <- paste0(GIS_data_path, '/Georgia Smart Communities/City_Limits.shp')

flu <- st_read(flu_path) %>% st_transform(epsg_id)
parcels <- st_read(parcel_path) %>% st_transform(epsg_id) %>%
  filter(!duplicated(`PARCEL_NO`))
clusters <- st_read(cluster_path) %>% st_transform(epsg_id)

city_points <- st_read(city_point_path) %>% st_transform(epsg_id)
city_limits <- st_read(city_limit_path) %>% st_transform(epsg_id)
roads <- st_read(roads_path) %>% st_transform(epsg_id)

highways <- roads %>%
  filter(Layer %in% c('State Highways', 'Interstates'))
```

Reapportion Cluster Data to Parcels
```{r}
p_c_join <- parcels %>%
  st_join(clusters, st_contains) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  
  #Count appearances
  count(`PARCEL_NO.x`, `C_Type`) %>%
  rename('PARCEL_NO' = 'PARCEL_NO.x') %>%
  group_by(PARCEL_NO) %>%
  arrange(-n) %>%
  filter(row_number() == 1) %>%
  add_count(`PARCEL_NO`) %>%
  mutate(keep = case_when(
    `nn` > 1 & C_Type == 'NA' ~ FALSE,
    TRUE ~ TRUE
  )) %>%
  filter(keep == TRUE) %>%
  filter(row_number() == 1) %>%
  select(-c(keep,n,nn)) %>%
  ungroup()

p_flu_join <- parcels %>%
  st_join(flu, st_intersects, largest = TRUE) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(c(PARCEL_NO, FLU))

#Merge with parcels
parcels_joined <- p_c_join %>%
  inner_join(p_flu_join, 'PARCEL_NO') %>%
  left_join(parcels %>% select(c(`PARCEL_NO`, `geometry`)), by = 'PARCEL_NO') %>%
  mutate(C_Type = case_when(
    is.na(C_Type) | C_Type == 'NA' ~ 'Not Suitable',
    TRUE ~ C_Type
  )) %>%
  st_as_sf(crs = epsg_id) %>%
  mutate(area = st_area(.) %>% units::drop_units())

check <- parcels_joined %>%
  add_count(PARCEL_NO) %>%
  filter(n>1)
```

```{r}
tmap_mode('plot')

henry_county_border <- tigris::counties(year = 2020, state = 'GA', progress_bar = FALSE) %>%
  filter(NAME == 'Henry') %>%
  select(geometry) %>%
  st_transform(crs = epsg_id)

tm_shape(parcels_joined %>% filter(!C_Type == 'Not Suitable'), bbox = st_bbox(henry_county_border)) +
  tm_fill(col = 'C_Type', palette = c('#d90e00', '#8cdeff')) +
  tm_shape(highways) +
  tm_lines(lwd = 2, col = 'Layer', palette = c('#fcba03', '#bab5a8'), legend.col.show = FALSE) +
  tm_shape(city_limits) +
  tm_borders(lwd = 1.5) +
  tm_shape(henry_county_border) +
  tm_borders(lwd = 2.5)

tm_shape(parcels_joined %>% filter(C_Type == 'Indus'), bbox = st_bbox(henry_county_border)) +
  tm_fill(col = '#d90e00') +
  tm_shape(highways) +
  tm_lines(lwd = 2, col = 'Layer', palette = c('#fcba03', '#bab5a8'), legend.col.show = FALSE) +
  tm_shape(city_limits) +
  tm_borders(lwd = 1.5) +
  tm_shape(city_points) +
  tm_dots(size = .1) +
  tm_text('Name', just = 'top', fontface = "bold", size = 0.8, style = 'pretty', shadow = TRUE) +
  tm_shape(henry_county_border) +
  tm_borders(lwd = 2.5)

tm_shape(parcels_joined %>% filter(C_Type == 'Indus'), bbox = st_bbox(henry_county_border)) +
  tm_fill(col = '#d90e00') +
  
  tm_shape(highways) +
  tm_lines(lwd = 2, col = 'Layer', palette = c('#fcba03', '#bab5a8'), legend.col.show = FALSE) +
  
  tm_shape(city_limits) +
  tm_borders(lwd = 1.5) +
  
  tm_shape(city_points) +
  tm_dots(size = .1) +
  tm_text('Name', just = 'top', fontface = "bold", size = 0.8, style = 'pretty', shadow = TRUE) +
  
  tm_shape(city_points %>% st_buffer(units::set_units(5, 'mile'))) +
  tm_borders(col = 'blue') +
  
  tm_shape(henry_county_border) +
  tm_borders(lwd = 2.5)
```

Create Final Regions Map
```{r, eval = FALSE}
regions <- parcels_joined %>%
  filter(C_Type == 'Indus') %>%
  st_transform(epsg_id)

st_write(regions, paste0(GIS_data_path, '/Georgia Smart Communities/Survey_Regions.shp'))
```

```{r}
regions_smoothed <- st_read(paste0(GIS_data_path, '/Georgia Smart Communities/Regions_Smoothed.shp'))

tmap_mode('plot') +
  tm_shape(regions_smoothed) +
  tm_fill(col = '#d90e00') +
  
  tm_shape(highways) +
  tm_lines(lwd = 2, col = 'Layer', palette = c('#fcba03', '#bab5a8'), legend.col.show = FALSE) +
  
  tm_shape(city_limits) +
  tm_borders(lwd = 1.5) +
  
  tm_shape(city_points) +
  tm_dots(size = .1) +
  tm_text('Name', just = 'top', fontface = "bold", size = 0.8, style = 'pretty', shadow = TRUE) +
  
  tm_shape(city_points %>% st_buffer(units::set_units(5, 'mile'))) +
  tm_borders(col = 'blue') +
  
  tm_shape(henry_county_border) +
  tm_borders(lwd = 2.5)
```

```{r}
parcel_flu_plot <- parcels_joined %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(`C_Type`, `FLU`) %>%
  summarize(area = sum(area))

ggplot(parcel_flu_plot) +
  geom_bar(aes(x = `C_Type`, y = `area`, fill = `FLU`), stat = 'identity', position = 'dodge') +
  labs(y = 'Area (m^sq)', x = 'Cluster Type', title = 'Cluster Type by Future Land Use Classification') +
  dark_mode()

ggplot(parcel_flu_plot %>% filter(C_Type == 'Indus')) +
  geom_bar(aes(x = `C_Type`, y = `area`, fill = `FLU`), stat = 'identity', position = 'dodge') +
  labs(y = 'Area (m^sq)', title = 'Cluster Type by Future Land Use Classification', subtitle = 'Industrial Clusters Only') +
  dark_mode() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

centroids <- st_read(paste0(GIS_data_path, '/Change/Centroid_Areas.shp'))
  

tmap_mode('plot')

tm_shape(regions_smoothed) +
  tm_fill() +
  tm_shape(centroids) +
  tm_dots(col = 'Area', size = 0.3) +
  tm_text('Cluster', just = 'top') +
  tm_shape(highways) +
  tm_lines()
```
